headline:
Every event has an audience.
Every screen has sound.
lede:
Business to Customer (B2C) engagement is where Audeohost lives, connecting venues and customers together.
You’ve got a chef in the kitchen, artists booked, paid live TV sport, a trainer in the gym, and a pool lifeguard.   
Whether it’s a match, or midweek event, nothing in your building goes unnoticed or unheard, and all need an ROI.

image.alt: The Audeo-Portal events schedule on a laptop next to a phone showing the same events live in the Audeohost-Events app
